description:
The Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana is a health insurance scheme initiated by the Government of Chhattisgarh. 

This scheme was launched on 1st December 2019. 

The primary objective of the Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana is to provide health insurance coverage to the economically weaker sections of society. 

The scheme aims to cover around 22 lakh families in the state of Chhattisgarh. 

It is designed to provide financial protection against high medical expenses incurred during hospitalization. 

The scheme covers a range of medical treatments and procedures. 

Beneficiaries can avail of cashless treatment in empaneled hospitals. 

The total coverage amount under this scheme is ₹5 lakh per family per year. 

This amount is applicable for secondary and tertiary healthcare services. 

The scheme also includes coverage for pre and post-hospitalization expenses. 

The Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana targets families living below the poverty line. 

It also includes families who are part of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. 

Families with an annual income of less than ₹2.5 lakh are eligible for this scheme. 

The scheme is particularly beneficial for those who do not have any other health insurance coverage. 

To apply for the Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana, beneficiaries must follow a specific process. 

The first step is to visit the nearest Common Service Center or the designated government office. 

Applicants need to fill out the application form provided at these centers. 

They must provide necessary documents such as proof of identity and income. 

Documents required include Aadhaar card, income certificate, and BPL ration card. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be verified by the concerned authorities. 

Eligible families will receive a health card under the scheme. 

This health card will allow them to access cashless treatment at empaneled hospitals. 

The disbursement of benefits under the Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana is done on a cashless basis. 

Beneficiaries can avail of services without any upfront payment at the time of treatment. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Health and Family Welfare, Government of Chhattisgarh. 

The department has established a network of empaneled hospitals across the state. 

These hospitals are responsible for providing the necessary medical services to beneficiaries. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of preventive healthcare. 

Health camps and awareness programs are organized to educate the public about health issues. 

The Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana is part of a broader initiative to improve healthcare access in Chhattisgarh. 

The state government aims to reduce out-of-pocket expenditure on health for low-income families. 

The scheme has been well-received since its launch. 

It has significantly increased access to healthcare services for the underprivileged. 

The government has also set up a helpline for beneficiaries. 

This helpline assists with queries related to the scheme. 

The Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana is a step towards achieving universal health coverage in the state. 

The scheme is aligned with the National Health Mission's objectives. 

It aims to enhance the quality of healthcare services available to the poor. 

The government has allocated a substantial budget for the implementation of this scheme. 

In the financial year 2020-2021, the government allocated ₹1,000 crore for the Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana. 

This funding is aimed at ensuring that all eligible families receive the benefits of the scheme. 

The scheme also includes provisions for maternity benefits. 

Pregnant women can avail of cashless delivery services under the scheme. 

Newborns are also covered under the health insurance policy. 

The Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana has provisions for various medical conditions. 

These include surgeries, cancer treatment, and treatment for chronic diseases. 

The scheme is designed to cover both inpatient and outpatient services. 

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness. 

Feedback is collected from beneficiaries to improve the services provided. 

The Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana is an essential part of Chhattisgarh's welfare initiatives. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving public health. 

The scheme has the potential to transform healthcare access for millions of families. 

The government encourages eligible families to apply for the scheme. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted to inform citizens about the benefits available. 

The Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana is a significant move towards equitable healthcare. 

It aims to alleviate the financial burden of healthcare on low-income families. 

The scheme is a crucial aspect of the state's development agenda. 

It seeks to ensure that no family is deprived of necessary medical care due to financial constraints. 

The Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana is a landmark initiative in Chhattisgarh's health sector. 

It sets a precedent for other states to follow in providing health insurance to the underprivileged. 

The scheme is expected to evolve over time with changing healthcare needs. 

The government remains committed to enhancing the scope and reach of the Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana. 

This commitment is reflected in the continuous allocation of resources and support for the scheme. 

The Mukhyamantri Abua Swasthya Suraksha Yojana is a vital resource for the people of Chhattisgarh.
